Hello @Vinh Luong ,

Thank you for providing the sample files for review.

We identified the reason our system was unable to process the files that were shared with us in the .zip archive. Those files were in plain, unencrypted format. Our system is built to receive files that are compressed and encrypted, which is how your data normally arrives through your regular transfer process. Because the files in the .zip did not match that expected format, our system could not complete the decryption step, and that is what caused the error.

To confirm this was specific to the .zip files, we also processed files coming through your standard transfer process as part of our QA upload. Those files processed successfully and the data has been loaded into our QA environment, so it is available there for you to review and test as intended.

If sample files need to be shared with us directly in the future, it would help if they are provided in the same compressed and encrypted format used by your regular file transfers, rather than as plain, unzipped data.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Kind regards,
Appriss Retail Support

Investigation update: 2026-09-21

Checked the 13 decrypted RAS/postrn test files against the 44 numbered test transactions Vinh listed (excluding the 4 "MCO-25878-..." entries, addressed separately below).

Finding: 33 of 44 transactions matched exactly (date + time + amount) against type-21 sale-header records in the raw files. The reason earlier searches came up empty is that each store's file timestamps are in local store time, not UTC, and the offset differs by store:

  • Store 25878 and 35002: UTC-4 (Eastern)

  • Store 47225: UTC-5 (Central)

Applying the correct offset per store, all 33 line up to the second, confirming the transactions are present in the files we received, contrary to what was seen in Secure QA.

Matched breakdown:

  • Store 25878: 26 of 37 matched, across files dated 20260827, 20260829, and 20260902.

  • Store 35002: 5 of 5 matched, across files dated 20260828 and 20260901.

  • Store 47225: 3 of 3 matched, across files dated 20260828 and 20260901.

Gap: The 11 unmatched store-25878 transactions all fall on Eastern local Aug 27, which requires ras.dltx.postrn.20260828.123400.00025878. That file is still missing from the batch, this is the same file Diego flagged as absent on 09/16. Once we get it, I'd expect all 11 to reconcile the same way.

MCO-25878-... entries: These 4 don't fit the RAS/postrn format at all. The numeric suffix decodes as a Unix epoch timestamp (e.g., 1788982126502531 -> 2026-09-09 19:28:46 UTC), which falls outside any file we have, and the literal string "MCO" doesn't appear anywhere in the RAS files. These look like Mobile Checkout Order references from a separate feed, not something we'd expect to find in postrn files.

Next step: Confirming with Peyman whether to (a) request the missing 20260828/00025878 file from Vinh's team, and (b) clarify with Vinh whether the MCO entries are a different transaction source before we spend more time searching for them here.
